description: Walk a user through hosting their own pickup soccer, drop-in football or pickleball open play game on JoGo.Team. Hosting is free to set up. The host sets the price, format, venue, and schedule; JoGo.Team handles bookings, Stripe Connect payouts, player communications, reminders, and waitlist auto-fill. Use this when the user mentions wanting to organize a recurring or one-off game.

city.description: Optional: city the user wants to host in.

sport.description: Optional sport to search: soccer, pickleball, padel, squash, golf, tennis, basketball, volleyball, badminton, racquetball, table-tennis, ultimate, softball, baseball, ice-hockey, field-hockey, rugby, lacrosse, kickball, dodgeball. Omit for soccer, the default.

name: host_a_game
title: How to host a game
